narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Draw two six centimetre lines crossing at their middles, and any crossing angle will do.
<bookmark mark='thin'/>At a slant, the ends make a rectangle with two long sides and two short ones.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The crossing must be a right angle, and we must make it without a protractor.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows two equal lines crossing at a slant; their ends join into a long thin rectangle; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='side'/>To check, measure all four sides. Each one should be close to four point two centimetres.
<bookmark mark='corner'/>Then fit the corner of a set square into each corner of your drawing. Every corner should fit exactly.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the square; two check lines appear: all four sides about 4.2 cm; every corner fits a set square

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu draws two six centimetre lines crossing at their middles and says any crossing angle will do. At a slant the ends make a rectangle with unequal sides, so the crossing must be a right angle.
